findings.scenario: Observe whether Verified advisories showing persistent access, exploitation of shared edge devices, or compromise across multiple infrastructure sectors moves in the direction of concern: Broader affected sectors, longer dwell time, destructive tooling, or repeated failure to apply mitigations
findings.observationCadence: weekly advisory scan and event-driven refresh
findings.measurableTrigger: A relevant verified advisory or discovery of an unmodeled single point of failure
findings.boundedResponse: Maintain a non-secret dependency inventory template and run isolated recovery simulations against published indicators
findings.rollback: Discard unverified indicators, isolate test artifacts, and restore the last known-good simulation baseline
findings.authorityBoundary: Automation may use public advisories and isolated test environments. Scanning third-party systems, accessing credentials, changing production networks, or disclosing sensitive findings requires explicit bounded authority; human escalation is limited to a proven credential, consent, or legal barrier.
